question: What is motion? 🚶
explanation: Excellent! Motion occurs when the position of an object changes with time relative to a reference point. 🌟
hint: Think about what happens when an object moves from one place to another.

question: An object is said to be at rest if its position does not change with respect to a reference point. 🪑
explanation: Wonderful! An object at rest maintains the same position relative to its surroundings. 🎉
hint: Focus on whether the position changes.

question: Which of the following is an example of motion? 🚴
explanation: Great job! A moving bicycle changes its position with time. 🌟
hint: Look for the object that is changing its location.

question: Which quantity tells us the total path covered by an object? 🛣️
explanation: Excellent! Distance is the total length of the path traveled. 🎯
hint: It depends on the actual route taken.

question: What is displacement? 🧭
explanation: Fantastic! Displacement is the shortest straight-line distance from start to finish with direction. 🌟
hint: It connects the starting and ending positions directly.

question: The SI unit of distance is? 📏
explanation: Excellent! The standard SI unit for distance is the meter. 🎉
hint: It is the basic unit of length.

question: Which quantity includes direction? 🧭
explanation: Great! Displacement includes both magnitude and direction. 🌟

question: What is speed? 🏃
explanation: Brilliant! Speed tells us how fast distance is covered. 🎯

question: The SI unit of speed is? 🏎️
explanation: Excellent! Speed is measured in meters per second in the SI system. 🌟

question: Velocity is defined as? 🧭
explanation: Wonderful! Velocity is speed with direction. 🎉
hint: It uses displacement instead of distance.

question: Which quantity is a vector? 🧭
explanation: Excellent! Velocity has both magnitude and direction. 🌟

question: A car covers 100 m in 10 s. What is its speed? 🚗
explanation: Great work! Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 100 ÷ 10 = 10 m/s. 🎯

question: Which motion repeats itself after equal intervals of time? 🔄
explanation: Excellent! Periodic motion repeats regularly. 🌟

question: The motion of a pendulum is an example of? 🕰️
explanation: Wonderful! A pendulum repeats its motion at regular intervals. 🎉
hint: It swings back and forth repeatedly.

question: Motion along a straight line is called? ➡️
explanation: Excellent! Linear motion takes place along a straight path. 🌟

question: A moving fan blade shows which type of motion? 🌀
explanation: Great! Fan blades move around a fixed center in a circular path. 🎯
hint: Think of rotation around a center.

question: What is uniform motion? 🚶
explanation: Excellent! Uniform motion means constant speed. 🌟
hint: The object covers the same distance every interval.

question: A train covers 50 km every hour. This is? 🚆
explanation: Wonderful! Equal distances covered in equal times indicate uniform motion. 🎉

question: What is non-uniform motion? 🚗
explanation: Excellent! Non-uniform motion means the speed changes. 🌟
hint: The object does not move consistently.

question: A bus speeding up and slowing down shows? 🚌
explanation: Great! Changing speed means non-uniform motion. 🎯

question: Acceleration is the rate of change of? 🚀
explanation: Excellent! Acceleration tells how quickly velocity changes. 🌟
hint: Think about speeding up or slowing down.

question: The SI unit of acceleration is? 🚀
explanation: Wonderful! Acceleration is measured in meters per second squared. 🎉

question: If velocity does not change, acceleration is? 🚗
explanation: Excellent! Constant velocity means no acceleration. 🌟

question: Which quantity can never be negative? 📏
explanation: Great! Distance is always positive or zero. 🎯

question: A runner completes 200 m in 20 s. What is the speed? 🏃
explanation: Excellent! Speed = 200 ÷ 20 = 10 m/s. 🎉

question: Which graph shows uniform motion? 📈
explanation: Wonderful! Uniform motion produces a straight line on a distance-time graph. 🌟
hint: Constant speed gives a constant slope.

question: A body moving around a clock face shows? 🕒
explanation: Excellent! The motion follows a circular path. 🎯

question: What is the unit of velocity? 🧭
explanation: Great! Velocity is measured in meters per second. 🌟

question: Which motion is shown by a child on a swing? 🎠
explanation: Excellent! The swing moves to and fro about a mean position. 🎉

question: Distance is a? 📏
explanation: Wonderful! Distance has magnitude only and no direction. 🎯

question: Velocity is a? 🧭
explanation: Excellent! Velocity has both magnitude and direction. 🌟

question: If a car travels 120 km in 2 hours, its speed is? 🚗
explanation: Great! Speed = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 km/h. 🎉

question: Which quantity depends on direction? 🧭
explanation: Excellent! Velocity changes if direction changes. 🌟

question: A person walks around a circular track and returns to the start. What is the displacement? 🏟️
explanation: Wonderful! Starting and ending positions are the same, so displacement is zero. 🌟
hint: Look at the final and initial positions.

question: Which quantity can be zero even when distance is not zero? 🧭
explanation: Excellent! Returning to the starting point makes displacement zero. 🎉

question: The slope of a distance-time graph represents? 📈
explanation: Great! The slope shows how quickly distance changes with time. 🌟

question: Which object is in rest relative to a passenger sitting in a train? 🚆
explanation: Excellent! The seat and passenger move together. 🎯

question: A stone dropped from a height shows? 🪨
explanation: Wonderful! The stone moves along a straight vertical path. 🌟

question: What happens to velocity if only direction changes? 🧭
explanation: Excellent! Velocity depends on both speed and direction. 🎉

question: Which quantity tells how fast an object moves? 🏎️
explanation: Great! Speed measures the rate of covering distance. 🌟

question: A vehicle moving with constant speed has? 🚗
explanation: Excellent! Constant speed means equal distances in equal intervals. 🎯

question: The motion of Earth around the Sun is? 🌍
explanation: Wonderful! Earth repeats its orbit in a fixed time interval. 🌟

question: A curved distance-time graph indicates? 📈
explanation: Excellent! A changing slope means changing speed. 🎉

question: Which quantity is always positive? 🛣️
explanation: Great! Speed represents magnitude only and cannot be negative. 🌟

question: If distance covered is zero, the object must be? 🪑
explanation: Excellent! No distance covered means no motion occurred. 🎯

question: A cyclist covers 150 m in 30 s. What is the speed? 🚴
explanation: Wonderful! Speed = 150 ÷ 30 = 5 m/s. 🎉

question: Which motion has no fixed path? 🎲
explanation: Excellent! Random motion occurs in unpredictable directions. 🎯

question: A body covers equal distances in equal intervals. Its speed is? 🏃
explanation: Great! Equal distances in equal times indicate constant speed. 🎉

question: What is needed to calculate speed? 🧮
explanation: Excellent! Speed is calculated by dividing distance by time. 🌟

question: Which concept helps us describe how objects move around us? 🚀
explanation: Brilliant! Motion helps us understand and describe the movement of objects around us. 🎉
hint: It is the main topic of this chapter.
